feed.title: NPR Topics: News
feed.subtitle: NPR news, audio, and podcasts. Coverage of breaking stories, national and world news, politics, business, science, technology, and extended coverage of major national and world events.

entry.title: DNA and vehicle-tracking help French investigators recover stolen Renoirs
entry.summary: DNA left on a protective painting cover helped investigators recover two stolen Renoirs and uncover what they suspected were preparations for another art heist, a French prosecutor said Monday.

entry.title: New White House press secretary a 'devoted fan' of Trump and MAGA
entry.summary: Katie Zacharia worked for one of Trump's companies and raised her profile appearing on conservative-leaning talk shows. She also amplified right-wing conspiracy theories. Now she'll be the president's chief spokesperson.

entry.title: Government spent $10 million on pro-Trump ads after president said super PAC would fund
entry.summary: Nearly $22 million in taxpayers funds has been spent to air the ads, with nearly half spent after Trump promised to fund what the White House calls public service announcements through his super PAC.

entry.title: Actor Selma Blair removed from plane by police after altercation
entry.summary: Authorities say Blair was physically abusive and injured two flight attendants while traveling from Los Angeles to New York. A Blair representative said she had a medical emergency aboard the plane.

entry.title: Federal agents search Rep. Ilhan Omar's DC home, DOJ says it approved the warrant
entry.summary: The Justice Department says the search is part of an "ongoing federal investigation", while Omar calls it "an attempt to target political enemies"

entry.title: India's opposition parties march to top court as protests over voter lists escalate
entry.summary: Opposition parties say revisions to the list of eligible voters favor Prime Minister Narendra Modi's party. Authorities have removed more than 130 million names from the voter roll.

entry.title: DOJ launches antitrust probe of TV networks. And, Trump says Ukraine needs new leader
entry.summary: The Justice Department is investigating several TV networks for possible antitrust violations. And, President Trump pressures Ukrainians to elect a new leader.

entry.title: U.S. restrictions on Chinese drones are hurting cash-strapped police departments
entry.summary: The U.S. government is trying to end the dominance of high-quality, low-cost drones made in China. But more restrictions mean higher costs for cash-strapped police forces that rely on those drones.

entry.title: Here's what to know if you're unsure about your measles immunity status
entry.summary: Vaccination is the best way to protect yourself against measles. For most adults, one shot of the MMR is considered enough protection. But there are certain situations that call for a second dose.

entry.title: Political strategist on how Trump's personal grievances could affect the GOP
entry.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep speaks with political strategist and former senior Republican congressional adviser Rina Shah about how President Trump's personal grievances and projects are affecting the chances of GOP candidates in the upcoming election.
